snippet.title: Mr. Sleepy Man Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1657740/Mr_Sleepy_Man/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie

Support our work in the indie scene:
https://patreon.com/sixoneindie

Follow us:

All Links - https://www.sixoneindie.com/

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
